_comment: Source registry. Add/disable/reprioritise sources here. 'adapter' is a module in /adapters. Manual-only sources have adapter 'manual'. Priority: primary | secondary | supplemental | fallback.

exclusive_data_types._comment: Data types where only ONE source may be used at a time (mixing would corrupt the data). Ordered by preference; the next source is used only when the previous one has no usable (non-quarantined) data, and the substitution is reported.

authoritative_player_sources._comment: Sources whose 'player' records may CREATE canonical players, merged in this order. 'team_authority' is the source whose team value wins when authoritative sources disagree (the one updated fastest after transactions).

history_series._comment: Which source/format feeds the raw market and consensus lines in value history (Model value history is always recorded).

sources.name: Sleeper
sources.terms: Documented public API, no key. Sleeper asks callers to stay under 1000 calls/minute and to fetch /players/nfl at most once per day.
sources.fallback: Player metadata also comes from the DynastyProcess crosswalk and nflverse players; cached Sleeper data is kept until replaced.

sources.name: Sleeper Projections (Rotowire)
sources.terms: Undocumented endpoint used by Sleeper's web app. Public, no key, CORS open. May change without notice.
sources.fallback: ESPN projections and manual projection imports provide independent projections.

sources.name: Sleeper Weekly Stats
sources.terms: Undocumented endpoint. Used as fallback for statistics and as the only free source of red-zone usage.

sources.name: FantasyCalc
sources.terms: Public JSON endpoint used by fantasycalc.com, no key, CORS open. Values are derived from real trades on connected leagues.
sources.fallback: DynastyProcess values and manual KTC import are alternative market inputs.

sources.name: DynastyProcess Values
sources.terms: Open dataset (GPL-3.0). Values are derived from FantasyPros dynasty ECR, so they are NOT independent of the FantasyPros consensus signal; weighted accordingly.

sources.name: DynastyProcess ID Crosswalk
sources.terms: Open dataset (GPL-3.0). Maps MFL, Sportradar, FantasyPros, GSIS, PFF, Sleeper, NFL, ESPN, Yahoo, Fleaflicker, CBS, PFR, Rotowire, KTC and other IDs.
sources.fallback: The persisted local crosswalk keeps every previously learned mapping.

sources.name: FantasyPros ECR (via DynastyProcess)
sources.terms: FantasyPros' site disallows automated access to /api/ and /json/ and its official API needs a partner key. The DynastyProcess open dataset republishes the weekly ECR snapshot, which is what we consume. Direct FantasyPros CSV exports can be added via Manual Import.
sources.fallback: Manual import of a FantasyPros rankings CSV export (Data → Manual Import → FantasyPros Rankings).

sources.name: nflverse
sources.terms: Open data (CC-BY 4.0 for most datasets). Release assets are fetched server-side (redirect to GitHub object storage).
sources.fallback: Sleeper weekly stats replace nflverse statistics automatically if nflverse is unavailable.

sources.name: Fantasy Football Calculator ADP
sources.terms: Documented free ADP API. No CORS headers, so it is fetched by the local server.
sources.fallback: Sleeper ADP fields; manual ADP import.

sources.name: ESPN Projections
sources.terms: Undocumented public endpoint behind ESPN's fantasy web app. Independent projection methodology from Rotowire. May change without notice; disable here if it breaks.

sources.name: KeepTradeCut
sources.terms: KTC Terms & Conditions §2.1 prohibit any automated data collection (scraping, bots). This app therefore never fetches KTC. You may import values you record yourself via Manual Import.
sources.fallback: FantasyCalc and DynastyProcess remain the automated market sources.

sources.name: FantasyPros (manual export)
sources.terms: Export from your own FantasyPros account/session and import here.
sources.fallback: Used when the DynastyProcess mirror is stale or unavailable.

sources.name: Manual Projections (FFToday or any site)
sources.terms: Any projection table you are permitted to download/copy.

sources.name: Manual Trade Values
sources.terms: Any trade-value table you are permitted to use.

sources.name: Manual Rankings
sources.terms: Any rankings list you are permitted to use.

sources.name: Manual ADP
sources.terms: Any ADP table you are permitted to use.

sources.name: Manual Rookie Pick Values
sources.terms: Any pick-value chart you are permitted to use.
